correctness.rationale: For each x-column the sloping boundary intersects one or two cells; integrating local squares gives exact Bernoulli variance phase v_alpha(q), and independent one-point-per-cell sampling yields Var=n^-4 sum_i v_alpha({i alpha}). Irrational rotations equidistribute by geometric Fourier sums and continuity of v_alpha, giving cubic integral g(alpha). Rational a/b gives exact period average with explicit finite Faulhaber sums and spike 1/(60ab^3). Reduced denominators diverging near an irrational prove continuity there; any rational has positive jump. Independently clipped half-planes to exact rational square polygons for slopes up to denominator 8 and multiple grids, agreeing with period coefficients, including alpha=1 and 1/2. Finite checks do not prove irrational equidistribution.
residual_risks: Only one independently jittered point per square, fixed slope 0<alpha<=1 as n grows; not uniform-in-slope.
No CLT, polygon generalization, or direct application-level material advantage follows.
